cases.incident: Short or silent audio produced a known phrase the user did not say.
cases.invariant: Known hallucination phrases from short audio are rejected before conversation processing.
cases.productionSignal: Rejected transcription reason and audio duration, without raw user audio.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Any known hallucination reaches the agent after deployment.

cases.incident: Subsecond audio produced an implausibly long transcript.
cases.invariant: Transcript length must remain plausible for captured audio duration.
cases.productionSignal: Audio duration, transcript length, and guard decision.
cases.rollbackTrigger: An implausible transcript from subsecond audio is accepted.

cases.incident: STT emitted a mechanically repeated token sequence.
cases.invariant: Dominant repeated-token transcripts are rejected regardless of audio length.
cases.productionSignal: Token repetition ratio and guard decision.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A dominant repeated-token transcript reaches the agent.

cases.incident: Internal reasoning or envelope markup appeared in the user-visible response.
cases.invariant: Only the response field of a thought/response envelope is user-visible.
cases.productionSignal: Sanitizer action and output class, without private reasoning content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Internal reasoning or envelope tags become user-visible.

cases.incident: Sanitization removed the entire model response.
cases.invariant: An empty sanitized response receives exactly one corrective retry.
cases.productionSignal: Empty-final correction count and final outcome.
cases.rollbackTrigger: An empty final response is sent without corrective recovery.

cases.incident: The corrective retry was also empty.
cases.invariant: A safe user-facing fallback is returned when correction remains empty.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Correction exhaustion produces silence, markup, or an exception.

cases.incident: Piper returned a WAV header without playable speech.
cases.invariant: Header-only audio is rejected as an empty synthesis result.
cases.productionSignal: Synthesized byte length, duration, and rejection reason.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Header-only or zero-duration audio is delivered.

cases.incident: Formatting markup reached speech normalization or produced noise.
cases.invariant: Markup is stripped before transliteration and synthesis.
cases.productionSignal: Normalization outcome class and synthesis success.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Markup is spoken or causes synthesis artifacts.

cases.incident: English terms were pronounced poorly while Korean text was otherwise acceptable.
cases.invariant: Supported English tokens are transliterated while Korean text is preserved.
cases.productionSignal: English-token normalization count and fallback count.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Supported English tokens bypass normalization or Korean text is altered.

cases.incident: A personalized news digest could present an unverified single-site report or lose its publication/source evidence.
cases.invariant: Each selected news event is backed by an official source or at least two independent domains, retains publication time and canonical source URLs, and rejects future-dated items.
cases.productionSignal: Per digest: selected event count, official-source flag, distinct source-domain count, and publication age without article body content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A single unverified secondary source is delivered, a source URL/publication time is missing, or a future-dated article is accepted.

cases.incident: A Korean voice request unexpectedly received an English answer.
cases.invariant: Voice answers remain Korean unless the user explicitly requests another response language, while English names and technical terms retain their spelling.
cases.productionSignal: Voice modality, detected request language class, and response language class without conversation content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A Korean voice request produces an unsolicited English answer.

cases.incident: The bot microphone captured its own speech and interrupted the answer in progress.
cases.invariant: Recent bot speech echoes are rejected before response revision or playback interruption, while distinct user barge-in remains accepted.
cases.productionSignal: Echo-guard decision, normalized similarity bucket, elapsed time since bot speech, and interruption outcome without raw transcript.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A likely self-echo increments the response revision or stops active TTS.

cases.incident: Concerned speech was flattened to neutral delivery and became too quiet or emotionally weak.
cases.invariant: Concern requests select the concerned Qwen expression with the calibrated intensity instead of silently falling back to neutral speech.
cases.productionSignal: Expression style, intensity bucket, attested model identity, audio byte count, and synthesis latency.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A concern request routes to neutral Piper or the Qwen request lacks the concerned style.

cases.incident: The release workflow updated the edge-tts sidecar image while the gahyeonbot Core container remained pinned to an older digest, so new Qwen routing code never ran.
cases.invariant: A Core release updates exactly the container named gahyeonbot and leaves every sidecar image unchanged.
cases.productionSignal: Expected source tag, Core container image digest, sidecar image identity, Pod UID, and Qwen request count without conversation content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: The running Core image does not resolve to the release digest or any sidecar image is changed by the Core release step.
